LanguageData.RR_Company_UnsupportedSave: This company record belongs to another Rimrooms version. Keep the original save and use the matching build.
LanguageData.RR_Company_InvalidStart: The company start is incomplete. Check the headquarters, starting staff and scenario report before continuing.
LanguageData.RR_Company_AlreadyStarted: This save already belongs to a company branch. A second start cannot replace its records or grant more supplies.
LanguageData.RR_Company_InvalidSave: Company records could not be reconciled. Company actions are disabled to preserve them. Keep the original save and review the Rimrooms log.
LanguageData.RR_Company_InvalidAmount: The quoted transaction is invalid. No payment was posted.
LanguageData.RR_Company_ReceiptMismatch: This operation ID already has a different recorded result. No second transaction was posted.
LanguageData.RR_Company_InsufficientFunds: The Company Account cannot cover this payment. Existing debts and physical stock remain recorded.
LanguageData.RR_Company_Inactive: No company branch is active in this save. Start the Async Industries scenario to establish one.
LanguageData.RR_Event_BranchStarted: Company branch established. The onboarding survey is accepted and the initial allocation is recorded.
LanguageData.RR_Event_OperatingArrears: Operating charges remain unpaid. Review the account and outstanding obligations.
LanguageData.RR_Company_CashExplanation: Company USD is an accounting balance. Silver, food, equipment and materials remain physical goods that staff must haul, store and use.
LanguageData.RR_Company_OpeningObjective: Next objective: prepare the machine, appoint its operator and review the AI-01 survey before dispatch.
LanguageData.RR_Company_MapUnavailable: The headquarters is unavailable. Its company records have been retained.
LanguageData.RR_UI_ContractValue: Quoted payment: {0} USD; optional records bonus: {1} USD
LanguageData.RR_UI_ContractTerms: Survey the route, record the distortion, recover the route recording and analyze it at headquarters. The optional bonus requires all three crew to return with route, distortion and entity observations. Combat is optional; a recoverable injury does not cancel the bonus.
LanguageData.RR_UI_LedgerRecent: Most recent 60 transactions are shown here. Earlier receipts remain saved in the company ledger.
LanguageData.RR_Coordinate_Discovered: Signal registered; site not yet visited
LanguageData.RR_Debug_RuntimeIdentity: Write build, loaded order and coordinate identity to Player.log
